No. 55/1/1/88-Cab.
GOVERNMENT OF INDIA (BHARAT SARKAR)
CABINET SECRETARIAT (MANTRIMANDAL SACHIVALAYA)

The undersigned is directed to say that with effect from
25th June, 1988 -

(1) Shri Narayan Datt Tiwari relinquished the office of
the Minister of Finance and Minister of Commerce.
(2) Prime Minister relinquished the office of Minister of
External Affairs.
(3) Shri P.V. Narasimha Rao relinquished the office of
Minister of Human Resource Development and assumed
the office of Minister of External Affairs.
(4) Shri P. Shiv Shanker relinquished the office of
Minister of Planning and Minister of Programme
Implementation and assumed the office of Minister
of Human Resource Development.
(5) Shri Vasant Sathe, Minister of Energy relinquished the
office of Minister of Communications.
(6) Shri Bindeshwari Dubey relinquished the office of
Minister of Law and Justice and assumed the office
of Minister of Labour.
(7) Shri Dinesh Singh relinquished the office of Minister
of Water Resources and assumed the office of
Minister of Commerce.
(8) Smt. Mohsina Kidwai, Minister of Urban Development
relinquished the office of Minister of Tourism.
(9) Shri Moti Lal Vora, Minister of Health & Family
Welfare relinquished the office of Minister of
Civil Aviation.
(10) Shri Z.R. Ansari relinquished the office of the
Minister of State (Independent charge) of the
Ministry of Environment & Forests and assumed the
office of Minister of Environment & Forests.
(11) Shri Jagdish Tyler relinquished the office of
Minister of State (Independent charge) of the
Ministry of Labour and assumed the office of
Minister of State (Independent charge) of the
Ministry of Food Processing Industries.
(12) Shri Shiv Raj Patil relinquished the office of
Minister of State in the Departments of Defence
Production and Supplies in the Ministry of Defence
and assumed the office of Minister of State
(Independent charge) of the Ministry of Civil
Aviation and Tourism.
